title: Jaguar Type 01 debuts; now, no one remembers the electric Ferrari
gist: Jaguar unveiled the Type 01 four-door all-electric GT, with 1,015 hp, ~400 miles range and an expected $120-130k price, arriving in US dealerships mid-2027; the author notes the design is controversial but defends it.

insights.claim: The Jaguar Type 01 has a 118 kWh usable 850 V battery, a 0.23 drag coefficient and about 400 miles of range, and a 350 kW DC fast charger can charge it from 10-80 percent in 22 minutes.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Competitive range and charging specs for a luxury EV GT.
insights.locator: Don't let the bluff angles fool you

insights.claim: The Type 01 has 1,015 hp, 1,007 lb-ft, all-wheel drive, all-wheel steering and 50:50 weight distribution, and is expected to cost $120,000-$130,000 with US dealer arrival in mid-2027.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Positions Jaguar at roughly double its prior $60,000 entry price in the luxury EV segment.

insights.claim: Jaguar cancelled a planned all-electric sedan and developed a new JEA EV platform, aiming for an elevated ownership experience and a starting price about double the brand's previous $60,000 entry point.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Brand-reset to higher price tier is a risky bet with no products on sale meanwhile.
insights.locator: The Type 01 is the first model

insights.claim: Jaguar's Formula E program, which won a third team championship in four years, has taught the company about efficient electric powertrains, benefiting road car silicon carbide inverters and traction control.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Motorsport tech transfer supports powertrain credibility.
insights.locator: Even though Jaguar hasn't had any new cars

insights.claim: The Type 01's exterior design has drawn broadly negative reactions, including from the author's colleagues, though the author does not dislike it and notes divisive design has precedent such as the Edsel and Cybertruck.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Design backlash is a sales risk to monitor for the relaunch.
insights.quote: But no one cares about any of that, because it seems mostly they’re all just mad about the way it looks.

insights.claim: The Type 01 interior features a 24-inch OLED dash screen and 7-inch touchscreen, and resembles the Range Rover GT, another JLR electric four-seat GT built on the EMA architecture.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Shared JLR architecture strategy across brands.
